retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.

requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent hero prop for an original modern animated Texas news film. Primary request: a single generic industrial condenser cooling cabinet, tall freestanding housing with two large circular fan grilles stacked vertically. Premium contemporary 3D editorial illustration with rounded machined edges, sculpted volume, sophisticated layered materials, a recognizable silhouette and exceptional surface finish. Full object including feet, three-quarter front view with its right side visible, isolated with real alpha on transparent background. Cabinet softly rounded brushed teal metal (#66ADA5) with ivory edge highlights, dark navy circular grille recesses, fine metallic cooling fins, convincing cylindrical depth in both fan openings, small brass fasteners, restrained warm copper pipe on the right side, tasteful minor surface wear. Motivated soft upper-left warm key light and cool fill, narrow rim highlights, soft subtle contact shadow. Rich tactile depth, no heavy black cartoon outlines, no flat vector rectangles, no retro clip art, no neon or sci-fi embellishments.
